title: FP8 concordance checker + staggered canary activation for E4M3/E5M2
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Ship FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) as an opt-in profile for selected Hopper-backed models with robust telemetry and an automated canary/staggered activation mechanism. We will not rely on a single binary enable. Instead, introduce a Concordance Checker that computes sample-level and token-level agreement metrics vs fp32 baseline, plus a staggered activation orchestration that progressively enables FP8 across shards, regions, and traffic slices. This ticket coordinates the checker, the shadow-canary runner, gating thresholds, and rollout automation hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Concordance Checker service runs nightly against the golden-seed suite and reports per-model metrics (token KL, top-1 logits agreement, beam-level BLEU/ROUGE where applicable).

Shadow Canary mode executed in prod for 0.5% of traffic with dual-execution (FP8 + float baseline) and telemetry surface visible in Console: token-level delta histograms, per-route drift score, and Canary Pass/Fail decision.
Staggered activation orchestration that can enable FP8 at shard, pod, and region granularity with hysteresis and automatic rollback if drift exceeds configured thresholds for N consecutive minutes.
Automated calibration job that consumes representative traces and produces per-layer scale factors; job writes calibration artifacts to s3://redwood-inference/fp8-calibs/<model>/<timestamp>.
Runbook and rollback playbook documented with links to PRs, dashboards, and play calls; on-call runthrough completed with SE/Reliability team.
implementation_notes: Concordance Checker: new microservice (concord-check) will replay golden-seed prompts through fp32 runtime (shadow) and fp8 runtime (candidate). Compute metrics: per-token logit KL, top-k overlap (k=5), token perplexity delta, and sequence-level CER/WER if labeled testcases exist.
Shadow Canary Runner: integrate dual-exec path into routing layer; ensure KV cache reuse doesn't bias results (use isolated cache for shadow runs). Add opt-in header X-RW-FP8-SHADOW.

Staggered Activation: orchestrator exposes activation-plan with steps: (1) shard-local (dev), (2) single-region low-traffic, (3) multi-region 1% traffic, (4) 5% traffic, (5) full. Each step requires Canary Pass computed from concordance metrics over a rolling 30m window.

Calibration Pipeline: batch job uses representative token distribution sampler, runs per-layer scale search grid, outputs both E4M3 and E5M2 candidates with safety margins. Candidate artifacts include per-op quant params and a confidence score computed from calibration residuals.

Gating thresholds: initial conservative thresholds: token KL < 0.02 mean, top-1 overlap > 98.5%, median token perplexity delta < 0.5, sequence BLEU/ROUGE change < 1.0% where applicable. Thresholds subject to tuning after first canary wave.

Telemetry: extend Console with 'FP8 Health' panel: per-model concordance timeseries, drift alerts (KL tail > threshold), and shadow sample viewer showing side-by-side logits + decoded outputs. Add retention 90 days for canary traces.

Safety: add per-route emergency-rollback API and an automated circuit breaker: if Canary Fail for > 3 minutes in a step, orchestrator reverts to previous profile and notifies PagerDuty channel 'infra-fp8'.

risks: Dual-execution increases per-request cost for shadow traffic; must cap to 0.5% initially to control burn rate.
KV cache isolation mistakes could mask latency regressions; extensive perf tests required before region rollout.
Initial gating thresholds may be too strict or too lenient; will require tuning on real traffic and labeled evals.
Model-specific sensitivity: some model families show high sequence-level sensitivity to per-layer scaling — keep conservative default and use model-specific overrides.
rollback_plan: Immediate: orchestrator toggles profile to previous release for affected shards. Escalation: if rollback does not restore metrics within 5 minutes, trigger full auto-rolloff and page SE+SRE. Postmortem: collect concordance run artifacts, save calibration candidates, and schedule hotfix for calibration parameters. Documented in runbook link.
next_steps: Schedule 0.5% shadow canary: create activation plan and calendar invite with SE, SRE, PM and Observability owners (target: 2025-02-24).
Expand golden-seed to 2k prompts covering chat, code, and retrieval scenarios; add labeled cases for sequence metrics.
Wire Canary pass/fail alert into PagerDuty and create Slack automation for immediate context push to #infra-fp8.
Run KV cache perf sweep in preprod to ensure no latency regression at shard-level before region rollout.
